description: Reference topology, not a resource provisioner or live node registry. Controllers use config/workers.example.json; host agents use fleet configuration. No cloud instances are created by this file.

planned.aliyunResources: Use existing ECS GPU instances or existing ACK GPU node pools; quantity is administrator-configured.

observedAtConfigurationTime.note: This is not live state. The UI exclusively reads actual registration/heartbeat records from GET /api/cluster.

controller.tls: Terminate HTTPS at an administrator-managed reverse proxy; keep browser/control-plane access restricted and validate server certificates in workers.
controller.credentials: A distinct bearer token per registered worker, injected from the tokenEnv named in the registry. Never place secret token values in this topology file.

localFleet.defaultNativeAF3Groups: One persistent process per visible GPU; 16 independent workers when all 16 GPUs are on the same host.
localFleet.multipleHosts: Split the host fleet into the actual devices on each server; device indices are host-local and worker IDs are cluster-unique.
localFleet.nativeMultiGpu: The included AF3 resident adapter uses one device. A multi-GPU model requires its own verified native adapter and group semantics; scheduling several devices does not add model parallelism.

aliyunFleet.placement: Existing ECS host service or ACK workload requesting an actual GPU allocation
aliyunFleet.dataAccess: Download prepared bundles and upload per-target results over authenticated HTTPS; do not remotely read the full local sequence database for each prediction.
aliyunFleet.interruption: Stop new claims, deliver completed targets if time permits, then rely on per-target lease recovery for unfinished work. Cloud interruption event integration is supplied by the deployment supervisor.

batching.meaning: Multiple compatible targets execute sequentially in one resident model process. This is not a claim of tensor minibatch support.
batching.compatibility: engine, database profile fingerprint, samples, recycles, runtime version, execution identity and coarse sequence-length bucket
batching.warmup: Weights load once per resident initialization; new shapes may still compile on first use.

demonstration.meaning: Both demo agents may run on the same loopback machine; location labels do not prove deployment in Alibaba Cloud.
